# Cluster

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Points labeled with a `cluster` number by k-means (turf.clustersKmeans) or by density (turf.clustersDbscan, with `dbscan` noise/core/edge). Runs turf in the engine.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{ "id": "n1", "op": "cluster", "name": "cluster", "x": 0, "y": 0, "params": {} }
```

An edge into it ends at `"targetPort": "in"`; one out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "out"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:clusters`, or read elsewhere as `ch('cluster/clusters')`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Port | Type | Takes |
|------|------|-------|
| `in` | `table` | one edge |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Parameters

<!-- gen:begin params -->
| Parameter | Kind | Default | Choices |
|-----------|------|---------|---------|
| `method` | `menu` | `"kmeans"` | `kmeans`, `dbscan` |
| `clusters` | `int` | `5` |  |
| `maxDistance` | `float` | `1` |  |
| `units` | `menu` | `"kilometers"` | `kilometers`, `meters`, `miles`, `nauticalmiles`, `feet`, `degrees` |
| `minPoints` | `int` | `3` |  |
<!-- gen:end params -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Port | Type |
|------|------|
| `out` | `table` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
